data._item_pattern_note: Item-level IDs — ML threat category slug (lowercase hyphenated) — are not yet enumerated. A catch-all pattern ^[a-z]+(-[a-z]+)*$ was removed 2026-08-13: it matched any arbitrary token, fabricating resolution results for unrelated queries and polluting free-text search. Prior research note: Conceptual taxonomy — threat categories described in the ENISA publication. No per-item URLs. Restore an item-level match_node once the real identifier list is confirmed (prefer known_values over an open pattern).
